__word_of_god: I'd like to preface this file with some information for people interested in making fan translations.
This file contains most dialogue/visible text in the game...
... but it's possible that some strings have been overlooked, and are still hardcoded into the game.
If you're working on a translation and encounter such a string,
, let me know!!! That's a bug to be reported & squashed.
Note that localization is still an experimental feature.
If you place another .json file in the text folder (e.g., 'de.json' next to 'en.json')...
..., then a language option will appear in the settings menu.
Also, at some point in this file, automated alphabetic ordering takes over.
Sorry in advance if that makes translation a little harder...
Thank you very much for playing my game and showing interest in it!
Whether you're here to work on a fan translation, ..
..., or you're just prodding at the game files for fun, ...
It means a lot to me.
